note: bamboo_twig_path (submodule of bamboo_twig) registers one Twig function bamboo_path_system(type, name=null) on service bamboo_twig_path.twig.path, wrapping extension.path.resolver->getPath(). type is core/profile/module/theme/theme_engine; returns the path relative to the Drupal root (empty string if not found). Medium cases are live introspection (path to olivero theme, to the bamboo_twig module). Hard cases have the agent write a Twig template (under web/sites/default/files/) rendered by verify: module path modules/contrib/bamboo_twig/bamboo_twig_path, theme path core/themes/olivero.

evals.prompt: What does bamboo_path_system do and what are its arguments and allowed type values?
evals.expected_output: bamboo_path_system(type, name = null) returns the filesystem path (relative to the Drupal root) of an extension; type is one of core, profile, module, theme, theme_engine (name ignored for core).

evals.prompt: Show a bamboo_path_system call that returns the path to a module named bamboo_twig in a Twig template.
What does bamboo_path_system return when the requested item is not found, and does it need a name for type 'core'?
evals.expected_output: It returns an empty string when the item is not found; the name argument is ignored for type 'core'.

evals.prompt: On this live Drupal site, using bamboo_path_system, what is the filesystem path to the 'olivero' theme?
On this live site, using bamboo_path_system, what path does it return for the 'bamboo_twig' module?
Using bamboo_twig_path, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_path_render_module.html.twig whose rendered output contains the filesystem path to the bamboo_twig_path module.
Using bamboo_twig_path, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_path_render_theme.html.twig whose rendered output contains the filesystem path to the olivero theme.
evals.expected_output: Write {{ bamboo_path_system('theme', 'olivero') }}; rendered output contains core/themes/olivero.
